sources.note: For Puruhá: nothing prosodic. The Cañari conclusions state the close affinity of Puruhá and Cañari and their differentiation ('debieron ser tan acentuadas [= marked] que.. estimaron los españoles que eran dos idiomas diferentes') and list toponymic finals (-ao, -eo, -deleg..) with Spanish orthographic accents on some names (Llakáo, Waladéleg) but no rule. The general index confirms Tomo I Cap. XI 'El Puruhá' = I. Territorio, II. Nombres geográficos y patronímicos grouped by finals (§A Caranqui-Cayapa-Colorado type, §B Panzaleo type, §C Puruhá-Mochica finals -cahuan, -cela, -lema, -tus, -bug,…
